BOUND CORRECTION 2026-08-02: fit_through_date was 2026-07-31T00:00:00+00:00 — max(game_date) read as MIDNIGHT — and has been corrected to 2026-08-01T12:00:00+00:00 via asof_invariant.bound_from_dates, the same convention the other four CBS inputs already use. The midnight reading is the ANTI-CONSERVATIVE one that bound_from_dates exists to prevent: a bare game_date parses to 00:00 UTC, which sits BEFORE the games actually played on that date, so this artifact would have passed an as-of check against a forecast committed at noon on 2026-07-31 while already containing that evening final. Nothing in the parquet changed; content_sha256 is unchanged.
